Deadwood Gardener.description: A feather from a Deadwood headdress, stained green at the quill. Featherkeeper Imna in Timbermaw Hold takes these ten at a time.

Deadwood Gardener.name: Fel-Tainted Seed Pouch
Deadwood Gardener.description: A Deadwood gardener's seed pouch. Whatever these grow into, the Timbermaw don't want it planted.

Chieftain Grimpelt.name: Deadwood Headdress Feather
Chieftain Grimpelt.description: A feather from a Deadwood headdress, stained green at the quill. Featherkeeper Imna in Timbermaw Hold takes these ten at a time.

Russet Boar.name: Russet Boar Haunch
Russet Boar.description: A heavy haunch of red-bristled boar. It'll feed a table of orcs, or two of elves.

Cliff Hippogryph.name: Cliff Hippogryph Plume
Cliff Hippogryph.description: A long gold-and-russet flight feather, stiff as a quill.

Southridge Shorecrab.name: Southridge Crab Meat
Southridge Shorecrab.description: Sweet white meat in a shell the size of a shield. It smells like the sea.

Eldarath Shade.name: Highborne Keepsake
Eldarath Shade.description: A small thing a Highborne carried: a comb, a ring, a cracked locket. The shade wanted it back.

Eldarath Construct.name: Construct Core
Eldarath Construct.description: A fist of violet crystal that hums when you hold it. It's still trying to give orders.

Mennar Mana Wyrm.name: Mana Wyrm Essence
Mennar Mana Wyrm.description: A vial of something that glows blue and tries to climb the glass.

Stormbay Siren.name: Siren's Pearl
Stormbay Siren.description: A black pearl carved with a rune the naga use. Dr. Okafor wants every one of them.

Bitter Reaches Raider.name: The Stolen Relic
Bitter Reaches Raider.description: A Highborne key of gold and moonstone as long as your forearm, still sticky with the dig's clay.

Promenade Noble.name: Court Seal
Promenade Noble.description: A Highborne noble's seal of office in sea-green gold. The Conclave can read the names on them.

Autumn Treant.name: Autumn Heartwood
Autumn Treant.description: A knot of red-gold heartwood from inside a treant. It's warm, and the grain runs in spirals.

Legash Felhound.name: Fel-Tainted Soil
Legash Felhound.description: A pouch of soil from under a felhound's paws. It's green at the bottom and it smells wrong.

Bitter Reaches Wavecaller.name: A Naga Dig Map
Bitter Reaches Wavecaller.description: A sharkskin map of the coast with digging marks along it. One of them is right under Eldarath, coming in from the sea.

Tunnel Slagcrawler.name: Seep-Glass Shard
Tunnel Slagcrawler.description: A sliver of black glass with a green light caught somewhere inside it. It's warm, and it shouldn't be.

Grave Ooze.name: Grave Tallow
Grave Ooze.description: A greasy lump skimmed off a grave ooze. It smells of candles and something worse.

Pustule Boar.name: Swollen Gland
Pustule Boar.description: A gland the size of a fist, tight and shining. Morwen wants them whole.

Plot Risen.name: Seep-Soaked Marrow
Plot Risen.description: Marrow from a thighbone, gone the colour of weak tea and glowing faintly at the break.

Tumour Wolf.name: Wolf Tumour
Tumour Wolf.description: A hard grey lump cut from a wolf's flank. Dr. Seitkali wraps every one in its own cloth.

Bridge Onlooker.name: Glowing Trinket
Bridge Onlooker.description: A button, a comb, a broken buckle, each of them glowing a soft green. Somebody picked it up because it was pretty.

Grosh'gok Sore-Shaman.name: Piece of the Grosh'gok Totem
Grosh'gok Sore-Shaman.description: A carved chunk of old wood painted with an ogre's handprint, small, like a child's.

Funnel Widow.name: Clean Widow Silk
Funnel Widow.description: A hank of silk from the inside of the funnel, where the glow never reached. It's as soft as anything you've ever touched.

Book Flock.name: A Page in Nine Hands
Book Flock.description: A page from Karazhan's library, written by one hand at nine different ages. The ink is fresh on all nine.

Gorge Slagcrawler.name: Slag Ore
Gorge Slagcrawler.description: A heavy lump of the slag that crusts the gorge, black and green, dense as lead.

Stopped Volunteer.name: A Liquidator's Kit
Stopped Volunteer.description: A canvas satchel with a beaked mask, a dosimeter and a ration tin in it. The name stitched inside the flap is still legible.

Aged Volunteer.name: A Liquidator's Kit
Aged Volunteer.description: A canvas satchel with a beaked mask, a dosimeter and a ration tin in it. The name stitched inside the flap is still legible.

Bubbler Ooze.name: Bubbler Pool Sample
Bubbler Ooze.description: A sealed flask of the seep from the bottom of the Bubbler Pools. It glows through the glass and the stopper.

Moonlit Wisp.name: Caught Wisp-Light
Moonlit Wisp.description: A soft white light that settles in your palm and doesn't burn. It dims when you're frightened and brightens when you're not.

Dissolving Stag.name: Dissolving Antler
Dissolving Stag.description: An antler from a Deadwind stag, soft at the tip where it's melting and hard at the base where it isn't yet.

Legash Satyr.name: Legash Satyr Horn
Legash Satyr.description: A satyr's horn, ridged and black. The Circle keeps a count of them, and has for ten thousand years.

Half-Coal Shambler.name: Living Coal
Half-Coal Shambler.description: Black, light and still a little soft. Coal before it finished becoming coal.

Feralas Stag.name: Feralas Stag Haunch
Feralas Stag.description: A haunch of lean red venison, wrapped in leaves to keep the flies off.

Ironfur Bear.name: Ironfur Pelt
Ironfur Bear.description: A thick dark pelt with a silver sheen down the back. It's warm enough to sleep under in the rain.

Woodpaw Trapper.name: Woodpaw Snare
Woodpaw Trapper.description: A loop of greasy rope tied to a bent stick. The knots are better than they have any right to be.

Lower Wilds Crocolisk.name: Crocolisk Belly Hide
Lower Wilds Crocolisk.description: A strip of soft pale hide from a crocolisk's belly, the only part of it a tanner wants.

Gordunni Ogre Mage.name: Scorched Gordunni Scroll
Gordunni Ogre Mage.description: A scroll an ogre mage was carrying. Most of it's burned, and what's left is in a hand much older than any ogre's.

Zukk'ash Tunneler.name: Lump of Raw Resin
Zukk'ash Tunneler.description: Amber resin, still soft, with grit and broken chitin pressed into it. It smells sweet and wrong.

Fog Grove Elk.name: Cut of Elk
Fog Grove Elk.description: A heavy cut of elk, dark red and lean. Walt says it's the best meat on either side of the world.

Feralas Stalker.name: Spore-Matted Fur
Feralas Stalker.description: A tuft of a stalker's fur, matted with fine grey spores that come off on your fingers like ash.

Hatecrest Ruin-Digger.name: Dug-Up Relic
Hatecrest Ruin-Digger.description: A piece of carved Highborne stone with fresh earth still packed into the lines, wrapped in kelp like something precious.

Isildien Ogre Mage.name: Page from the Dome
Isildien Ogre Mage.description: A page of Highborne script on something that isn't paper. It's ten thousand years old and it doesn't tear.

Dread Chimaera.name: Chimaera Scale
Dread Chimaera.description: A hard green scale with a ridge of bone along it. The Sentinels use them to count kills.

Rage Scar Yeti.name: Singed Yeti Fur
Rage Scar Yeti.description: A handful of a yeti's fur, burned at the tips as if something hot had come very close.

Hatecrest Makrura.name: Makrura Tail Meat
Hatecrest Makrura.description: A pale, sweet length of tail meat in its shell. The Sentinels pretend they don't like it.

Kolkar Wrangler.name: Salvaged Caravan Crate
Kolkar Wrangler.description: A battered supply crate, contents mostly intact despite everything.

Kolkar Outrunner.name: Salvaged Caravan Crate
Kolkar Outrunner.description: A battered supply crate, contents mostly intact despite everything.

Bark Lizard.name: Bark Lizard Hide
Bark Lizard.description: A flat, rough hide patterned exactly like the bark the lizard lived on. Ka'lisa says it makes the best quiver leather there is.

Reef Shellcrusher.name: Root-Threaded Shell
Reef Shellcrusher.description: A crab's shell with fine roots grown through it like veins. The scouts use them as bowls.

Sap-Drunk Crocolisk.name: Sap-Thick Blood
Sap-Drunk Crocolisk.description: A stoppered gourd of crocolisk blood, thick and faintly gold. It doesn't clot.

Rootbound Murloc.name: Root-Grown Fin
Rootbound Murloc.description: A murloc's fin with a root grown right through the webbing. The root is still alive.

Goldensap Ooze.name: Clot of Living Sap
Goldensap Ooze.description: A clot of the ooze, still trying to move. Tazjin says to carry it in a closed jar and not to look at it too long.

Bloodsail Sap-Tapper.name: Bloodsail Tapping Ledger
Bloodsail Sap-Tapper.description: A greasy ledger of barrels tapped and barrels sold, with prices that make Fizzle whistle.

Bloodscalp War-Climber.name: Bloodscalp Climbing Plan
Bloodscalp War-Climber.description: A strip of hide painted with the tree's roots and a line of red handprints going up the north-west one. Somebody's planning a raid.

Bough Python.name: Bough Python Skin
Bough Python.description: A long green-gold skin, supple and strong. The trolls wrap their ladder rungs in it so wet hands don't slip.

Silkwood Weaver.name: Spool of Silkwood Silk
Silkwood Weaver.description: A spool of web silk, thick as twine and stronger than rope.

Silkwood Weaver.name: Silk-Wrapped Bronze
Silkwood Weaver.description: A piece of engraved bronze the spiders wrapped up like prey. It hums faintly through the silk.

Silkwood Weaver.name: Web-Wrapped Crystal
Silkwood Weaver.description: A chip of blue crystal wrapped tight in spider silk. It's warm through the web.

Amberdrip Ooze.name: Clot of Amber Sap
Amberdrip Ooze.description: A clot of the ooze that's set hard as amber, with a gnat caught in it.

Canopy Howler.name: Ape-Hoarded Crystal
Canopy Howler.description: A chip of blue crystal, worn smooth by an ape turning it over in its hands.

Mossback Skink.name: Mossback Skink Hide
Mossback Skink.description: A soft hide with a mossy green back. It makes good harness leather.

Bloodscalp Ropecutter.name: Knotted Climbing Cord
Bloodscalp Ropecutter.description: A short cord tied in a row of knots, each a different kind. Bloodscalp climbers use them to tell each other where the next ropes will go up.

Glimmerwing Moth.name: Pinch of Glimmer Dust
Glimmerwing Moth.description: Wing dust from a Glimmerwing Moth. It glows faintly gold, and the ward's lamplighters mix it into their lantern oil.

Lichenwing Moth.name: Pinch of Pale Dust
Lichenwing Moth.description: Wing dust from a Lichenwing Moth, grey-green and fine as ash. Burned on a coal, it smells of rain.

Scuttling Gear-Drone.name: Bronze Drone-Cog
Scuttling Gear-Drone.description: A small toothed wheel of bronze, still warm. Every tooth is cut exactly the same.

Rotheart Treant.name: Rotted Heartwood Splinter
Rotheart Treant.description: A splinter of heartwood gone soft and dark, threaded through with pale white strands.

Rotspore Cloud.name: Rotspore Sac
Rotspore Cloud.description: A papery sac of spores from the heart of a Rotspore Cloud. It puffs grey when it's squeezed.

Rain Darter.name: Spark of Caught Rain
Rain Darter.description: A drop of rain that won't stop falling, held in a darter's light. It's falling upward at the moment.

Howler Monkey.name: Kapok Seed-Pod
Howler Monkey.description: A seed-pod from a kapok tree, split and spilling the soft white fluff the monkeys line their beds with.

Cloudtop Wyvern.name: Cloudtop Crest-Feather
Cloudtop Wyvern.description: A long blue-grey feather from a Cloudtop Wyvern's crest, stiff as a quill. It hums faintly when the wind crosses it.

Crackling Wisp.name: Shard of Storm-Glass
Crackling Wisp.description: A twist of dark glass that forms where a Crackling Wisp spends itself against the bark. It's still warm, and it makes your hair stand up.

Thunderhawk.name: Thunderhawk Quill
Thunderhawk.description: A heavy flight quill from a Thunderhawk, banded dark and pale like a storm sky.

Skiff Sentinel.name: Humming Crystal
Skiff Sentinel.description: A pale crystal from a Skiff Sentinel's chest. It hums one low note that never changes, and it's cold to touch.

Ascendancy Shield Drone.name: Shield Focus
Ascendancy Shield Drone.description: A palm-sized lens of blue crystal from an Ascendancy Shield Drone. It still hums, and the air in front of it feels thick.

Ascendancy Legionary.name: Sealed Legion Orders
Ascendancy Legionary.description: A thin plate of crystal etched with Aetherian script and sealed with the Ascendancy's sigil. Every legionary carries a copy.

Ascendancy Sky Lancer.name: Highbough Spear
Ascendancy Sky Lancer.description: A troll hunting spear with teal paint on the haft, taken as a trophy by a sky lancer.

Ascendancy Bombardier.name: Stolen Survey Page
Ascendancy Bombardier.description: A page of the survey's records in the Patient Lens's tidy hand, creased where a soldier folded it into his pack.

Ascendancy Artillerist.name: Stolen Survey Page
Ascendancy Artillerist.description: A page of the survey's records in the Patient Lens's tidy hand, creased where a soldier folded it into his pack.

Waking Guardian.name: Rune-Cut Shard
Waking Guardian.description: A flake of grey stone off a Waking Guardian, cut with Kharad runes so small and deep they look like cracks.

Bolt-Born Elemental.name: Charged Mote
Bolt-Born Elemental.description: A bead of light left where a Bolt-Born Elemental came apart. It crackles if you bring it near metal.

Gilded Moth.name: Pinch of Gold Dust
Gilded Moth.description: The fine gold dust off a Gilded Moth's wings, wrapped in a leaf. It numbs your fingers.

Construct Hound.name: Hound Gyro
Construct Hound.description: A spinning brass core from a Construct Hound's chest. It keeps turning long after the hound's stopped.

Crashfall Scuttler.name: Piece of Skiff Crystal
Crashfall Scuttler.description: A splinter of the council skiff's crystal, dark now, dragged off the wreck by a Crashfall Scuttler that liked the shine.

Cloudfleece Ram.name: Cloudfleece Shank
Cloudfleece Ram.description: A lean shank off a Cloudfleece Ram. The meat's pale and smells faintly of rain.

Kharad Sentinel.name: Sentinel Ward-Core
Kharad Sentinel.description: A fist of grey stone from a Kharad Sentinel's chest, cut with the same runes as the wards that brought the skiff down. It's warm.

Molten Crystal Elemental.name: Cooled Forge-Glass
Molten Crystal Elemental.description: A lump of crystal that was molten inside a Molten Crystal Elemental and set hard when it fell. It's cloudy and doesn't shine.

Skymane Lion.name: Skymane Sinew
Skymane Lion.description: A long cord of sinew from a Skymane Lion. It's stronger than any rope Tethertown has.

Ascendancy Scout Construct.name: Scout Patrol Log
Ascendancy Scout Construct.description: A crystal plate from an Ascendancy Scout Construct, etched with the routes it flew and the times it flew them.

Anchorlight Wisp.name: Mote of Anchorlight
Anchorlight Wisp.description: A bead of gold light left where an Anchorlight Wisp came apart. It's warm, and it pulls very slightly toward the First Anchor.

Ascendancy Engineer.name: Second Anchor Drift Log
Ascendancy Engineer.description: An Ascendancy Engineer's slate, scratched with readings of the Second Anchor. Every line is a little worse than the one before.

Overflow Elemental.name: Clear Overflow Glass
Overflow Elemental.description: A lens of clear crystal that set inside an Overflow Elemental when it came apart. Light goes through it without bending at all.

Wreck-Rubble Elemental.name: Fallen Archive Plate
Wreck-Rubble Elemental.description: A thin plate of stone from the island that fell, cut close with writing, pried out of a Wreck-Rubble Elemental's back.

Ascendancy Warden.name: Ascendancy Marching Orders
Ascendancy Warden.description: A slate of orders in a clipped military hand, sealed with the Ascendancy's mark and not the council's.

Keel-Crystal Shard.name: Keel-Grown Lens
Keel-Crystal Shard.description: A disc of crystal that grew in the dark under the Third Anchor. Held up to the light, it shows things a little closer than they are.

Garden Repair-Drone.name: Clean Gold Graft
Garden Repair-Drone.description: A cutting of gold-apple wood, wrapped and sealed by a Garden Repair-Drone that never stopped doing its job properly.

Tiltside Goat.name: Tiltside Goat Shank
Tiltside Goat.description: A lean shank off a Tiltside Goat. It'll take all day in the pot, and it'll be worth it.

Censor-Inquisitor.name: Rescued Plate Fragment
Censor-Inquisitor.description: A shard of an old stone plate, cut close with writing, that a Censor-Inquisitor was carrying to the braziers.

Mounted Sky Lancer.name: Construct Steed Core
Mounted Sky Lancer.description: The crystal heart of a Mounted Sky Lancer's bronze steed. Without it, the steed is a statue.

Smoke Jelly.name: Cool Smoke-Jelly Gel
Smoke Jelly.description: A handful of cool, clear gel out of a Smoke Jelly. Spread on a burn, it takes the heat out at once.

Keel Construct.name: Keel Core Governor
Keel Construct.description: The governor out of a Keel Construct's chest, the part that tells it which keel to lay next.

Harvested Storm.name: Storm-Charged Rainwater
Harvested Storm.description: A flask of rain wrung out of a Harvested Storm. It fizzes a little, and it's the cleanest water on the Bastions.

Cinder Ray.name: Cinder Ray Fillet
Cinder Ray.description: A thick white fillet off a Cinder Ray. It's already half cooked from the inside.

Bastion Legionary.name: Legionary Ration Tin
Bastion Legionary.description: A sealed tin of Ascendancy field rations off a Bastion Legionary: dried meat, hard bread and a twist of good spice.

Lightning Elemental.name: Overcharged Collector Crystal
Lightning Elemental.description: A crystal grown inside a Lightning Elemental, so full of charge it hums against your palm.

Fading Wisp.name: Guttering Light
Fading Wisp.description: A little light caught out of a Fading Wisp, still warm. The shrine at Lastlight can burn it.

Ascendancy Cutter.name: Unspent Forge Crystal
Ascendancy Cutter.description: A crystal an Ascendancy Cutter prised out of the Threefold Forge's hearth. It's never been used, and it still holds its light.

Broken Construct.name: Working Gear Assembly
Broken Construct.description: A gear assembly out of a Broken Construct that still turns when you push it. Up here that makes it valuable.

Quarter Sentinel.name: Schoolroom Slate
Quarter Sentinel.description: A child's writing slate from the Emptied Quarter's school, kept safe for forty years by the Quarter Sentinel that took it.

Waking Forge-Guardian.name: Rune-Cut Flue Stone
Waking Forge-Guardian.description: A stone off a Waking Forge-Guardian's shoulder, cut with Kharad runes too big to read close up.

Ascendancy Scavenger.name: Saar Family Silver
Ascendancy Scavenger.description: A bundle of old silver cups and spoons an Ascendancy Scavenger carried out of a house in the Emptied Quarter.

Siege Legionary.name: Sealed Fleet Orders
Siege Legionary.description: Orders under the Ascendant-General's own seal, carried by a Siege Legionary for the Moorage.

Siege Artillerist.name: Fleet Supply Ledger
Siege Artillerist.description: A Siege Artillerist's copy of the fleet's supply ledger: grain, crystal and shot, and a date at the bottom of every page.

Eyrie Echo.name: Song-Struck Feather
Eyrie Echo.description: A grey feather that hums when the wind gets up. Whoever lived here once wove them into a song.

Falling Star.name: Chip of a Falling Star
Falling Star.description: A splinter of hot crystal from a star that fell into the rings and kept on burning.

Lost Sky-Sailor.name: Sky-Sailor's Tag
Lost Sky-Sailor.description: A bronze tag on a chain, stamped with a ship, a berth and a name worn almost smooth.

Sun-Pitcher.name: Pitcher-Plant Nectar
Sun-Pitcher.description: Clear, sweet and faintly sour, from the bottom of a pitcher plant's bell. Don't drink it.
